Package com.example.demo.repository

Interface AuditLogRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<AuditLog,Long>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<AuditLog,Long>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<AuditLog,Long>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<AuditLog,Long>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<AuditLog,Long>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<AuditLog>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<AuditLog,Long>
@Repository public interface AuditLogRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<AuditLog,Long>
审计日志数据访问接口

提供审计日志的数据库操作方法，继承自JpaRepository获得基础CRUD功能。
